title: Kinematics toolbox: model-free differentiation and integration of measured motion
description: Model-free differentiation and integration of measured motion in Python and MATLAB: velocity and acceleration from a noisy displacement record, velocity and displacement from a drifting accelerometer, and fusion of both channels. Spectral, Savitzky-Golay, Whittaker-Henderson, Tikhonov, smoothing-spline, total-variation, Levant, Gaussian-process and delay-reconstruction (SSA/SOD) estimators, and a self-tuning state-space (Kalman/RTS) smoother that handles gaps, multirate and non-uniform sampling. Includes a benchmark on a Duffing free decay with exact ground truth. Developed at the Nonlinear Dynamics Laboratory, University of Rhode Island.
